l.i: CVrru quadrijugo Jaccheus Honoris ad edem Maximus ingenio fertur, & arte potens.
Si Sophiã pandat, cūcti pendemus ab ore. Eloquium forsan tale Platonis erat.
Nec satis hoc. Eadem gaudet signare libellis, Quos velit esse suos divus Aristoteles.
Adde quod, ut quondam Podalirius atque Machaon, Ab Stygis innumeros asserit ille lacu.
Nunc etiã optatas profert in luminis oras, Quæ placeant Coo Pergameoq; seni.
Dicite, quanta vir is mereatur præmia laudis, Qui, quæ vix aliy singula, juncta tenet.

page.notes: The initial C is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "Vrru" as printed. Some words in the verse are doubtful, notably "Vrru" and "Jacchcus", and "aliy" and "juncta" as printed. The left edge carries a fragment of the facing page, not transcribed. The catchword "Excla-" is printed at the foot right.
